title: ChatAgentPoll
description: chat.agent-poll@1 (the Agent Streams plan, S5): a poll the agent asks a Co-pilot room to run, and the result it gets back. The agent writes the question and two to four options ('Which name: parseRows or readTable?') and the poll is open for 30 to 120 seconds. Chat draws it as a poll card with buttons; `!1` to `!4` vote too. One vote per person, one poll at a time, and at most one poll every five minutes. The owner (or a moderator) can close a poll early or veto its result. A poll can only choose between the options the agent wrote: Chat never adds one. The result carries the counts, nothing else about who voted.

room.description: The room the poll is in: an agent stream's room, `agent:<ags_id>`.

options.description: The options the agent wrote, two to four of them. Chat never adds an option of its own.

id.description: The option's number: `!1` to `!4` vote for it.

label.description: The option's text, as the agent wrote it.

votes.description: How many people chose it. The count is in the result; it says nothing about who.

closes_at.description: When the poll closes on its own: 30 to 120 seconds after it opened.

closed_at.description: When the poll was closed early by the owner or a moderator, or null when it ran its time.

state.description: Where the poll stands: open, closed (the counts are final), or vetoed (the owner or a moderator refused the result).

result.description: The result, once the poll is closed: the counts and the winning option. Null while the poll is open.

counts.description: How many votes each option got, in the order the options were written.

winner.description: The option that won, or null when there was no vote or no winner.

vetoed_by.description: Who vetoed the result (the owner or a moderator), or null. Never a person's id: the handle only.
